FlightsLiveStamp.description: A live file's stamp: its UTC minute, YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ.

FlightsSlot.description: One of the three live files the passes take in turn.

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

stamp.description: That file's stamp. The three slot files are reused in turn, so a reader takes a slot file as current only when its own stamp is this one; any other stamp is an older pass (a cached copy) and is stale.
